title: Learn content and resources
contract: Learn View provides structured modules with video and explanatory text; modules can be added without a Live update. Its home page links to the manual and Knowledge Base. Available lesson catalog, delivery service, download/cache and authenticity protocol remain unknown.

title: Learn entry and in-session page retention
contract: Close Learn with its X and reopen from Help or Ctrl+Alt+7 Windows/Cmd+Option+7 macOS. Before Live closes, reopening returns to the last visited page. First-open default visibility is documentary only, not an observed target constructor default; application-restart restoration remains unknown.

title: Lesson filter, completion and navigation
contract: Lessons can be filtered by topic and marked completed. Complete Lesson gives a home-page check mark. Lesson Home or < Lessons returns home; bottom related-lesson links are described only when home shows all lessons. Completion persistence across application/reinstall/account contexts is unknown.

title: Lesson player controls
contract: The lesson player offers play/pause, progress scrubbing, volume, subtitles and picture-in-picture controls. This lists named public controls, not decoder support, actual video/audio output, subtitle languages or timing precision.

title: Picture-in-picture window transitions
contract: Opening lesson picture-in-picture closes Learn and allows window movement/resizing. Its X closes it; Learn View arrow reopens Learn and closes picture-in-picture. The source describes always above application windows, including other apps; the arrow then brings Live into focus. OS permissions, exclusive/fullscreen conflicts and geometry persistence remain unknown.

title: Lesson playback position and seek roles
contract: Within picture-in-picture, hover exposes progress and backward/forward 15 controls. While Live remains open the lesson video resumes from the prior position, even after closing either view during playback. Exact seek interval units, endpoint rounding, transport ordering, audio/video timing and decoder output are not calibrated here.

title: Learn connectivity and reload
contract: Learn View requires an Internet connection. Following loss and reconnection, Reload refreshes it. The text does not establish offline-cache behavior, authentication, network error text, retry policy or recovery deadline.

title: Info View contextual help and visibility
contract: Info View displays the hovered UI element name/function. Its bottom-left view toggle or ? key shows/hides it. Exact help strings, keyboard-layout/focus conflicts, hover delay and accessibility announcements are unknown; global key context remains with keyboard navigation.

title: Track and device Info Text entry points
contract: Track/device context-menu Edit Info Text opens editable notes in Info View; the chapter describes notes saved/displayed with the Set. Clip Edit Info Text remains owned by REQ-CLIP-VIEW-004, not duplicated here. Text codec/limits, undo and exact persistence/error transactions remain unknown.

title: Platform Settings entry
contract: Settings opens from Options on Windows or Live menu on macOS, or Ctrl+, Windows/Cmd+, macOS. Keyboard traversal/close/page shortcuts and preferred-language selection remain with keyboard-navigation; no crossplatform key equivalence is inferred.

title: Window zoom roles
contract: Display settings offer separate zoom for main window, second window if open, and Settings window. Mouse adjustment of Settings zoom updates after mouse-button release. Offered range, scale arithmetic, permonitor layout and persistence are unknown; preferred language belongs to keyboard-navigation.

title: Display option roles
contract: Display Options includes Outline View in Focus, scrollbar presentation, Arrangement/clip Follow and UI-label visibility. Enabling Outline draws a border around the selected view. Exact option enums and underlying Follow navigation/transport behavior remain with relevant view owners or unknown.

title: Mouse and pen settings
contract: Mouse and Pen Input exposes Pen Tablet Mode, permanent scrub areas and pitch-locked MIDI drawing options. Actual pen protocol, gesture thresholds, scrubbing audio and note drawing remain with editing owners or unknown.

title: Suppressed warning restoration
contract: Application Options can restore warning dialogs previously suppressed through Don't Show Again. The warning set, exact dialog text, perwarning/global scope, account and restart retention remain unknown.

title: Theme and appearance controls
contract: Theme offers a color scheme, light/dark or OS-follow appearance, warm/cool/neutral palette tone and high contrast. Customization adjusts grid opacity, brightness, color intensity and hue. Numeric ranges, color values, assets and OS-change propagation timing remain unknown.

title: Track and clip color preferences
contract: Track and Clip Colors controls automatic track colors, a default track color and Reduced Automatic Colors. Clip Color may choose random colors or track color for new clips. No palette enumeration, random distribution or color-sequence oracle follows. This preference context qualifies the Clip View new-clip inheritance wording; matched target resolution remains unknown.

title: Audio device and system-output settings
contract: Audio settings expose input/output devices, sample rate/latency and calibration testing. The source describes macOS CoreAudio and Windows driver selection/driver-owned management, recommending ASIO without prohibiting other drivers. macOS Use System Device follows the OS Sound output choice. Accepted devices/drivers/rates, fallback and transition artifacts remain unknown.

title: Library settings and Places labels
contract: Library settings choose default Pack/User Library locations and dependent-file copying when moving clips/tracks/presets to Browser. They also show/hide Cloud, Push and Splice Places labels. General file-copy/project and Browser operations remain with existing owners. Visible labels do not establish service availability, credentials, cloud protocol or target feature presence.

title: Licenses and Updates settings category
contract: The chapter identifies Licenses and Updates settings for authorization, automatic updates and usage data. It supplies no detailed command surface, default consent, telemetry payload, update protocol, rollback or entitlement rules; those remain required unknowns.

title: Installation, authorization and update operations
contract: Installation/authentication/license entitlement, online/offline authorization, usage-data consent and telemetry, update/download/install/rollback, OS permissions and recovery remain required unknowns. SET-B003 is a source pointer and publisher licensing prose, not a new independently interpreted license contract.

title: Settings, help and media lifecycle
contract: Malformed/boundary input, unavailable content/device, cancel/undo/persistence/restart, focus/mapping conflicts, monitor/rate changes and teardown remain unknown.
